summary: Montrose hiker slipped on loose gravel on the Bear Creek Trail about half a mile below Grizzly Bear Mine, injuring a knee and unable to walk. An eight-person OMRT crew hiked in and carried him out on a wheeled litter.
location: Bear Creek Trail, south of Ouray
notes: Lack of cell service forced the reporting party to hike down for coverage.
